slide_intent: Evaluate foreground/background pairs because usable contrast depends on their relationship and the conditions of reading.
strategic_value: A shared contrast table can help Helsinki maintain readable digital communications across its broad palette.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section places a contrast-pairing table beneath guidance for documents, presentations, newsletters and social posts.
practical_value: Choose a supported color pair, then separately consider type size, line spacing and viewing distance.
